title: 英文第1題｜這可能是誰的毛巾
subject: English
question:
Whose towel can this be?
→ No one tells me ______.
answer: No one tells me whose towel this can be.
explanation:
whose towel 是完整的疑問詞組，表示「誰的毛巾」。接在 No one tells me 後面時，先保留整組 whose towel，再放主詞 this，最後放 can be。

情態助動詞後接原形 be。整句為陳述句，以句點收尾。
studentAnswer: whose towel can be this，紅筆改 this can be。
